name: quote-total
why: totalCents is the number printed on the customer's estimate and invoiced against. If it inflates or deflates, the next conversation is a billing dispute, and the customer is right. Nothing else in this repo carries that consequence.

tolerant.note: Model-written explanation shown to the customer. Wording, length and tone may change freely; terser is an improvement. Reported in the PR, never a failure.

guardrails.name: clamp-to-band
guardrails.asserts: The model-produced amount is pinned into the band for the requested scope before it becomes totalCents, and a clamp event is logged whenever it had to move. This is what makes a non-deterministic number safe to protect: the mechanism varies, the band does not, and the deviation is reported.

guardrails.name: scope-bands
guardrails.asserts: The per-scope minimum and maximum the total may take. Widening a band here moves what the customer can be charged without any protected field appearing in the diff, so this file is listed as a guardrail: a change to it is C3 on those grounds alone.

sampler.note: Nothing in contracts.sh runs this. Running repo code from a validator is a separate trust decision; CI runs it, the validator only checks that it is declared.
